newsitem.title: USA: Fischer Imaging sees Q3 revs at $20 mln.
newsitem.headline: Fischer Imaging sees Q3 revs at $20 mln.

text.p: Fischer Imaging Corp said it expected to report third-quarter revenues of about $20 million, compared to $19.1 million last year, and break even with its operating earnings compared to $1 million last year.

The company said it was disappointed with the preliminary figures. Order rates were weak and the earnings were hurt by a softening demand as well as a lower absorption of fixed manufacturing costs, the company said.
"We are taking necessary actions to reduce expense levels," said Morgan Nields, chairman and chief executive.
The company makes X-ray imaging systems.
